title: AI Service QoS: An Independent Outside-In Measurement Methodology, with Case Study 1 (Qwen3.8-Max / Qoder)
description:
Executable tooling, methodology and written material for AI Service QoS — Independent Measurement of What Users Actually Receive (methodology v0.1): the collector and anonymiser that turn a client's own runtime log into request-level service-quality measurements, the assertion script that re-derives every published figure, and the method document with Case Study 1 (Qwen3.8-Max through the Qoder CN IDE and Alibaba Cloud Model Studio). This record is created by Zenodo's GitHub integration from a repository release, so it describes the software.

Licensing is split by path and Zenodo holds one licence field: the tooling under scripts/ and tools/ is MIT; the text, tables, figures and evidence data in the same archive are Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (see LICENSE, LICENSE-content.md, LICENSE-code.md). The request-level evidence is archived separately as a dataset record under cc-by-4.0.

Pre-release, last revised 2026-09-11. Cite a snapshot — the release tag or commit, not a branch — and name the collection round and the client version rather than the model alone.
